rows.ARS:
Orange-pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: KORtember
rows.Bloom: Salmon-orange. Strong fragrance. 20 petals. Double (17-25 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, pointed buds.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy, upright. Semi-glossy, leathery foliage.

Height: up to 4' (up to 120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b through 10b. Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden. Vigorous. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Parentage:
Fragrant Cloud (hybrid tea, Tantau 1963) ×
Uwe Seeler ®
